blocks.text: Let $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ be nonsingular and $b\in\mathbb{R}^n$. With $x_0=0$, $r_0=b$ and $\beta=\|r_0\|_2$, GMRES [saad1986] computes
Algorithm alg:arnoldi builds an orthonormal basis $V_m$ of $\mathcal{K}_{m}(A,r_0)$ and $\bar H_m\in\mathbb{R}^{(m+1)\times m}$ with

blocks.label: eq:arnoldi

blocks.text:
Arnoldi with modified Gram--Schmidt
Require: $A$, $r_0$, $m$
$v_1 \gets r_0/\|r_0\|_2$
for $j = 1,\dots,m$ do
  $w \gets A v_j$
  for $i = 1,\dots,j$ do
    $h_{ij} \gets v_i^\top w$ ▷ projection
    $w \gets w - h_{ij} v_i$
  end for
  $h_{j+1,j} \gets \|w\|_2$
  if $h_{j+1,j} = 0$ then
    return ▷ invariant subspace
  end if
  $v_{j+1} \gets w / h_{j+1,j}$
end for
blocks.label: alg:arnoldi

blocks.text: (Least squares). By (eq:arnoldi) and (eq:orth), $x_m=V_m y_m$ with $$y_m=\mathop{\mathrm{arg\,min}}_{y\in\mathbb{R}^m}\|\beta e_1-\bar H_m y\|_2 .$$
blocks.label: thm:ls

blocks.text: For $x=V_m y$, $b-Ax=V_{m+1}(\beta e_1-\bar H_m y)$, and $V_{m+1}$ has orthonormal columns.
In exact arithmetic, GMRES terminates in at most $n$ steps.
blocks.label: lem:term
